records.issue_text: src/sentry/spans/buffer.py:197: Changing existing span-buf:s: Redis keys from sets to sorted sets without migration or versioning causes WRONGTYPE errors for predeployment buffers and prevents mixed-version workers from sharing the keys.
records.rationale: The diff shows Redis commands changing from set operations (sadd, scard, sscan, sunionstore) to sorted set operations (zadd, zcard, zscan, zunionstore) on the same key pattern 'span-buf:s:{project_and_trace}:{span_id}'. records.issue_text: src/sentry/scripts/spans/add-buffer.lua:47: ZUNIONSTORE sums duplicate members' scores by default, inflating timestamps when spans are reprocessed and causing eviction to retain older spans over newer ones; AGGREGATE MAX is needed to preserve timestamp scores.
records.rationale: The diff shows ZUNIONSTORE being used at lines 47 and 52 in add-buffer.lua without specifying AGGREGATE MAX. The code uses end_timestamp_precise as scores (seen in buffer.py line 196-198 where zadd uses span.end_timestamp_precise as the score).
